I reviewed the changes from `6d854db` to `2bfabf5`: 23 files, +580 −233. They move the Safe address book to the shared paginated table and fit the Spaces tables to narrow screens. I found no blocking defects and five low-to-medium issues.

**This is a draft, not the full scored review.** I checked the diff and each finding myself, reading the surrounding code and the Cypress page objects. I didn't run the nine separate review agents or the paired agents that try to confirm or knock down each finding. The skill only produces a score when that paired check has run, so there is no score or verdict. Running `/safe-code-review` with no arguments does the full check.

## Findings

| # | Priority | Area | Where | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P2 | Regression | `apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.tsx:221` | The Safe address book lost its rows-per-page picker (10 / 25 / 100). |
| 2 | P3 | Accessibility | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/RequestToAddButton.tsx:105` and `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:196` | On narrow screens, "Requested" and "Already shared" are labelled in a way screen readers ignore. |
| 3 | P3 | Bugs (layout) | `apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.tsx:205` | The action buttons sit on the left under a right-aligned "Actions" header below 900px. |
| 4 | P3 | Conventions | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:141` | A comment was cut off mid-sentence. |
| 5 | P3 | Conventions | `apps/web/src/components/common/EnhancedTable/index.tsx:137` | A doc comment still says "nine existing consumers"; there are now eight. |
| 6 | P3 | Testing | `apps/web/src/components/address-book/AddressBookTable/index.test.tsx` | Nothing tests the new narrow-screen layout or address sorting of the Safe address book. |

### 1. Rows-per-page picker removed (P2)
- **What:** The old table offered 10, 25 or 100 rows per page. The new table always shows 25. The old table's own deprecation note (`EnhancedTable/index.tsx:135-139`) lists this as a known gap, so moving this table drops the feature.
- **Effect:** Someone with 200 contacts who used to view 100 at a time now has to page through 8 pages. Nothing breaks and the Cypress pagination tests still pass, but it's a visible feature loss on a busy page.
- **Fix:** Either add a page-size option to `PaginatedDataTable` before switching, or call the loss out in the PR description so product can accept it.

### 2. Narrow-screen labels are not read out (P3)
- **What:** The "Requested" clock icon and the "Already shared" check icon rely on `aria-label` on a plain `<span>` with no role. The accessibility rules don't allow names on plain elements, so most screen readers skip them. The icons themselves are hidden from screen readers.
- **Effect:** A screen-reader user on a phone hears nothing for these rows. The test at `RequestToAddButton.test.tsx:126` passes only because the test library accepts the label anyway.
- **Fix:** Add `role="img"` to the span, or put the text in a visually hidden `<span className="sr-only">`.

### 3. Action buttons misaligned (P3)
- **What:** The actions column is right-aligned, but it reuses the old table's `.actions` style. That style switches to `justify-content: flex-start` below 900px (`EnhancedTable/styles.module.css:41-44`).
- **Effect:** From 600 to 900px this mismatch already existed. It now also appears on phones, which used to get a separate mobile card layout.
- **Fix:** Use an inline `flex justify-end gap-1`, as the Spaces tables do, instead of the old table's class. That also drops the tie to the deprecated table's stylesheet.

### 4. Truncated comment (P3)
The diff deleted the line "the table card below it." Line 141 now ends mid-sentence at "…almost touching". Restore that line.

### 5. Out-of-date consumer count (P3)
The doc comment still says "nine existing consumers". Without the address book there are eight: AssetsTable, OwnerList, ProposersList, NestedSafesList, RecoverySettings, SpendingLimitsTable, PositionGroup and PositionsSkeleton. The design-system story's "~9" note is loose enough to leave.

### 6. Missing tests (P3)
The new tests cover staying on the page and the search reset. Nothing tests:
- the address appearing under the name on narrow screens;
- the address column being dropped there;
- sorting by address (Cypress covers this, but no unit test does).

If the table's compact behaviour broke, no unit test would fail.

## Checked and fine
- **Cypress selectors still match.** `table-row`, `table-container`, `next-page-btn`, `prev-page-btn` and `table-cell-name` are all present on the new table. The reordered address-sort steps in `address_book_2.cy.js` match the new sort cycle (ascending, descending, off). The old table had no default sort either, so first-load order is unchanged.
- **Page reset logic is sound.** The table now tracks the list of row keys. Editing or deleting through a dialog no longer jumps back to page 1, while search, filter or delete still does. The out-of-range page guard is still there.
- **Column widths add up to 100%.** Every Spaces address book setup gives 100%: the "mine" tab with its extra action comes to 20+30+15+35. The members list widths didn't change. The 2FA column's move into the row details is tested, including declined invites.
- **Security:** nothing found. The diff is UI only, with no signing, auth or data-fetching changes.

## Worth tidying (optional)
- The Safe address book builds its own "address under the name" cell. It matches the new `AddressCell`, but that component lives in the Spaces feature, which a shared component shouldn't import. Moving `AddressCell` to `components/common` would let both use it.
- `.storybook/COVERAGE.md:807` and `:1741` still list the table at its old `features/spaces/...` path.

## Not covered
- The full check: nine separate review agents, paired confirmation of each finding, and a score.
- Running tests, type-check or Cypress, as you asked.
- Checking the layout in a browser. Findings 2 and 3 come from reading the markup and CSS.
